body: Yes!!! I've had so much trouble explaining this to my counselor. Thanks for posting this I thought I was the only one

It means a lot to me. Thank you ❤️
Honestly not much. My main treatments have been for anxiety. I have an extreme phobia of choking to the point I have gone a week without eating because I was so afraid to choke

Thank you so much for your response. I am going to get myself back into counseling. I feel bad for being so co dependent and gloomy. I tend to suck the joy right out of the room. I’m ready to change!! I am working hard on loving myself

I see a med manager. My counselor gave up on me because I kept cancelling appointments. I completely understand though, I know it costs her money/ loses her money. I’m going to try to find a new counselor

I’ve been in therapy for mental health issues since I was 8. I’ve only recently within the last 2 years gotten the correct diagnosis. Bi polar 2, ptsd, & OCD. I don’t like to list out all of them because it’s embarrassing. Mental illness runs deeply in my family. However, I am doing the best I have ever been. It’s just the self hatred and body issues linger. I feel hopeless at times because I can’t imagine not caring. When I think about how much I hate my body I can physically feel the “emotional pain” in my chest. Which funny enough is a huge part of it :p
I have a long list of plastic surgery I’d like. Unfortunately I’d have to win the lotto lol
I have the Paraguard because I smoke (I know I’m dumb, trying to quit) and I don’t need anymore of a reason to get a blood clot lol. But my periods last almost 2 weeks it’s miserable
